subject: Self-serve demo — IT whitelist, preferred windows & finalizing AE/SE time
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@northbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Intro + self-serve signup — next steps for IT and scheduling

Hey team,

Quick heads up — Northbridge filled out the self-serve trial and asked for a live walkthrough to validate latency and whitelisting requirements. Lina (CC) is their IT lead. She indicated they need a short security checklist before routing traffic.

Proposed plan:
- AE (Karthik) runs a 30–40m product + pricing overview
- SE (Jasmine) does a 30m deep-dive on network & deployment (whitelisting, IP ranges, SSO surface)
- Include IT/Network contact to confirm firewall / proxy rules

Lina, could you confirm which of the following windows work on your side (all times in CET)?
- Tue 27 Apr: 09:00–11:30 or 15:00–17:00 CET
- Wed 28 Apr: 14:00–17:00 CET
- Thu 29 Apr: 08:00–10:30 CET

I’ve attached our short IT checklist for Northbridge to review. Also sharing a Calendly link; if you prefer I can send a couple of proposed invites.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood-it-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 38KB)]
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro-demo?event=NB-2027-042

Thanks — I’ll hold the AE/SE slots until we confirm.

— Aditya
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@northbridge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Weber <markus.weber@northbridge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Intro + self-serve signup — next steps for IT and scheduling

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the checklist. A couple of quick notes from IT: 

- We need IP ranges and FQDNs for outbound requests (we run strict egress rules).
- We cannot accept vendor-initiated webhooks on our public IPs; any callbacks must be routed through our proxy (we'll provide proxy host).
- Preferred windows are Wed 28 Apr 14:00–16:00 CET or Thu 29 Apr 08:00–09:30 CET (shorter preferred).
- Please avoid Fri afternoons CET — patching window.

I’ll gather Markus (security architect) on the thread; if you can provide the IP list + domain names, I can pass them to our network team and unblock ahead of the demo.

Regards,
Lina Gomez
Lead IT Operations, Northbridge Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@northbridge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + self-serve signup — next steps for IT and scheduling

Lina — perfect, thanks for the clarity. We can do Wed 28 Apr 14:00–15:00 CET for the joint session (30–45m). Jasmine and I can split the agenda: 20m product/flow, 20m SE/network & Q&A.

IP / domain details below (high level) — I’ll follow up with a formal list as well:
- Outbound IPs: 34.201.12.0/24, 34.201.13.0/24 (CDN/edge pool)
- Service endpoints: api.redwood-inference.com, auth.redwood-inference.com
- Callback endpoint: callbacks.redwood-inference.com (can be proxied)

Attaching a calendar block with the proposed 14:00 CET slot. If you need a different slice, happy to move.

Attachments: [attachment: ae-se-availability.ics (text/calendar, 1KB)]

Karthik Iyer

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro + self-serve signup — next steps for IT and scheduling

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 08:20 -0400 Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Lina — perfect, thanks for the clarity. We can do Wed 28 Apr 14:00–15:00 CET for the joint session (30–45m).

Hi Lina — quick technical note from SE: if your proxy requires TLS inspection we recommend an allowlist by FQDN rather than IP (cert pinning can be impacted). For the demo we can disable webhook callbacks and run the demo in a read-only mode if that helps avoid network changes.

Also, we typically record the session for internal alignment; we can stop recording on request and redact logs.

If Wed 28 at 14:00 CET is good, I’ll prepare a short runbook (15m) for what to expect and a lightweight pre-demo checklist for your network team.

— Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@northbridge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Confirmed: Wed 28 Apr 14:00–15:00 CET — invite & prep

Next steps for Northbridge IT: please confirm once the network team has applied the temporary allowlist or agrees to proxy the callbacks (we’ll run read-only by default). If you want us to provide a signed IP list file or a vendor onboarding form for procurement, tell me and I’ll attach it.
